newsitem.title: USA: Maine tries to draw more tourists inland.
newsitem.headline: Maine tries to draw more tourists inland.

text.p: Maine is trying to lure tourists to the inland areas of the state, using new television advertizements.

Gov. Angus King unveiled advertizements, which promote the fishing, white water rafting and mountain hiking possibilities in the northern and western parts of the state, at a State House news conference.
King says the state is continuing it's effort to attract tourist to the coastal areas as well. But he adds, the inland regions are under utilized and unknown by many visitors to the state.
